b: If you shop Home Depot’s Black Friday 2026 tool deals and gift center, you’ll find a large end cap display with a ton of Milwaukee hand tools.
This is what it looked like at the start of the season. It looks very different now.
Each tool special-buy is already at a discount.
But, if you want some variety, or need to stock up on a particular tool, the “buy more, save more” offer gives you even greater value.
Buy 3 eligible tools, and you save an extra $10. Buy 5, and you save an extra $30.
Here are the eligible tools, which are $20 each:

25ft Compact Magnetic Tape Measure 2-Pack
Rafter and Trim Square 2-Pack
FastBack Utility Knife with Screwdriver 2-Pack
Multi-Bit and Stubby Screwdriver 2-Pack
2pc Adjustable Pliers Set
Folding Hex Key Sets
Because all of the promo sets are $20 each, the extra discount is $10 off $60 or $30 off $100.
Whatever you do, don’t get 4, as that would be 4 for $70. Throw one more in your cart and pay the same price.
